title: Full observability: Sentry + uptime + alerting
goal: Operate production web observability with Sentry, Redis monitoring, correct liveness and readiness contracts, actionable alerts, release metadata, and a successful staging soak

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Web Sentry errors and traces are release-tagged and verified in isolated staging and production; mobile observability is explicitly deferred
GET and HEAD /healthz return consistent unauthenticated liveness and /readyz reports redacted Supabase, Redis, and required-service readiness
Uptime, Redis, authentication, checkout, webhook, and elevated error-rate alerts route to an acknowledged on-call owner
A 99.9% monthly web/API SLO and runbooks are published
A 24-hour staging soak completes without unresolved P0/P1 operational defects

evidence: 2026-09-09: local validator reports Sentry absence as explicit disabled state without emitting DSN values.
2026-09-09: health smoke is loopback-only and did not contact a remote environment.

2026-09-10: /healthz parity gap fixed in next.config.ts (additive rewrites /healthz -> /api/health); npm run smoke:healthz PASS (exit 0) against booted local app; /api/health returned 200 {"status":"ok"}.
Transferred from the v1 task; this gate does not keep a locally complete domain implementation active.

progress.summary: Production-readiness audit promoted RELEASE-003 to P0. Web launch requires release-tagged Sentry, Redis and key-flow monitoring, consistent GET/HEAD liveness, redacted readiness, owned alerts/SLOs, and a 24-hour staging soak; mobile remains deferred.
completed: Added local validation output that explicitly identifies disabled Sentry and rate limiting.
next_steps: Provision web/mobile Sentry, uptime for /healthz plus auth/session and checkout, separate auth/checkout alerts, a 99.9% monthly web/API target, and the on-call destination.
blockers: No local application is running; real Sentry DSN, uptime provider, alert routing, and SLO values are outside the local pass.

checkpoints.summary: Local Sentry stays disabled unless a non-production DSN is supplied; /healthz smoke rejects all non-loopback targets.
checkpoints.next: Collect runtime health evidence after local configuration is complete.

checkpoints.summary: Local /healthz parity gap fixed: added additive rewrites() in next.config.ts mapping /healthz -> /api/health (vercel.json was Vercel-only). Smoke now passes against a booted local app: 200 {status:ok}; /api/health identical at 200. Sentry/uptime/SLO remain unprovisioned and env-dependent.
next_steps: Provision non-production Sentry project + uptime/SLO config for the observability acceptance gate.
